game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Cold Larder, an ice-cellar larder: the hold guard must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the hold guard calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Cold Larder: an ice-cellar larder
core_gameplay_loop: In Cold Larder, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the hold guard calls throughout the level. Each round, frozen golems strike the beacon fire, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the library value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the beacon fire from frozen golems in Cold Larder: keep the library meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: library drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Cold Larder.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 24 seconds while library > 0.
